in_marathi.name: Jayitri
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayitri हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jayitri is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Jaya' meaning victory. The suffix 'tri' adds the meaning of 'triumph' or 'success'. This name was used in Hindu mythology for goddesses and princesses who embodied strength and triumph over adversity.
